# ceph_monitors (Data Source)

Lists the Ceph cluster's monitors and their public addresses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ceph_monitors" "all" {}

output "mon_addrs" {
  value = data.ceph_monitors.all.monitors[*].public_addr
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `monitors` (Attributes List) All monitors in the cluster, ordered as returned by the monmap. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))

<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Read-Only:

- `addr` (String) Monitor address.
- `in_quorum` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is currently part of the quorum.
- `name` (String) Monitor name.
- `priority` (Number) Monitor priority within the monmap.
- `public_addr` (String) Monitor public address.
- `rank` (Number) Monitor rank within the monmap.
- `weight` (Number) Monitor weight.
